reels.name: 01_Can_You_Stop_The_Train_In_GTA6
reels.title: CAN YOU STOP THE GTA 6 TRAIN?!
reels.hook: CAN YOU FINALLY STOP THE TRAIN?!
reels.reason: Live stream gameplay testing whether high-speed vehicle roadblocks and collisions can derail or stop the GTA 6 passenger train.
reels.post_caption:
CAN YOU FINALLY STOP THE GTA 6 TRAIN?! In GTA 5 the train was literally indestructible, but in GTA 6 next-gen physics allow real derailment and collisions! Share this with a friend who thought it was invincible!
